SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

How sweet it is, O Lord, That though still on earth, Yet we have above, With Thee our true home; For where Thou now sittest, In faith our rest we have found; For us heaven is opened, Since Thou hast gone from the grave.

2.

In spirit already there, Soon we, who on Thee believe, In body and soul perfected, With Thee may eternally dwell. Thy Father’s gracious care Makes the path of thirst bright, Thy countenance makes joyful Our way to the Father’s house.

3.

The Comforter here below Comforts us with Thy grace And gives us already a foretaste Of all Thy counsel of love. With favour Thou dost cheer us And ever surroundest us here, Until the new name Our brow shall once bear.

4.

Thy glory we await; Our home is not here, But among the redeemed throng With Thee, our beloved Lord. No place can rightly please us Where Thou art not, And to be with Thee Is now our soul’s desire.

Text: Efter O Lord, how blest our journey av Mary Peters, 1856. Musik: Confidence, anonym, 1903. 7.6.7.6 D
